parameters.content:
## Track Mercado Libre Argentina offer prices

### How it works
Run manually for one keyword on Mercado Libre Argentina. This workflow starts a charge-capped, listing-only [FalconScrape Mercado Libre Listings Scraper](https://apify.com/piotrv1001/mercado-libre-listings-scraper) run and writes ARS offer observations to Google Sheets. **Mercado Current** holds the latest price for each listing offer ID. **Mercado History** holds one dated observation per run and offer. **Mercado Runs** records the Apify run ID for recovery. The first observation is a baseline; later runs compare the same offer ID and currency. A catalogue product ID or matching title never substitutes for an offer ID. Sponsored click-tracking redirects are rejected rather than stored as product links. Missing offers are not marked sold out. Listed prices omit delivery and may not reflect personalized promotions.

### Setup
1. Choose your **Apify API** credential on the Apify HTTP nodes and **Google Sheets OAuth2** on the Sheets HTTP nodes. Create an empty spreadsheet and enter its ID in **Configure search**.
2. Enter one keyword and keep the first test at 20 items with a $0.09 Actor charge ceiling. Select **Execute workflow**. Three tabs are created automatically. The template is free; Actor runs and n8n hosting may cost money. The listing-only Actor event price is separate from the charge ceiling.
3. If execution stops, inspect **Mercado Runs** and the Apify log. When no execution is active, clear a stale **_MERCADO_WORKFLOW_LOCK** tab and set **resumeRunId** to the saved run. n8n cancellation does not cancel Apify.

### Customization
Use a separate spreadsheet for every keyword and market. This template is fixed to Argentina and ARS; it does not perform FX conversion. Archive before 5,000 rows per tab. Scheduling is off until you confirm the first output and cost.

## 1. Set one Argentina search
Enter one Mercado Libre keyword and an empty spreadsheet ID. Start with 20 listings and a $0.09 Actor charge ceiling. These nodes validate input and Sheets access before paid work.

## 2. Prepare protected history tabs
The workflow creates **Mercado Current**, **Mercado History**, and **Mercado Runs**. A temporary lock prevents overlapping imports. Existing rows and capacity are checked before scraping.

nodes.name: 3. Start a new scrape or resume one

parameters.content:
## 3. Start or recover a bounded run
Leave **resumeRunId** blank for a new listing-only Argentina run. A saved run ID resumes its original dataset without starting another scrape. The Actor, query, site, and settings must match.

nodes.name: 4. Save the run ID and wait

parameters.content:
## 4. Save the ID and await success
Before polling, the run ID and original query are saved in **Mercado Runs**. A failed or unfinished Actor run does not import. Inspect Apify before any retry because n8n cancellation does not stop the Actor.

## 5. Compare identical offer IDs
Only MLA offers with valid ARS prices and direct product links are imported. Sponsored click-tracking redirects are rejected. The listing offer ID is the comparison key, never the catalogue ID or title.

## 6. Release lock and review counts
After successful writes, the workflow releases its lock. **Run summary** reports baselines, price changes, rejected rows, and replay counts. Missing offers are unobserved, not automatically sold out.
